# Pinned independent evaluator handoff

The submission directory contains executable install/serve and historical public-reproduction commands. Validation downloaded and hashed the six actual release checkpoint files (about 62 MB), verified their pinned model/base/temperature metadata against a clean loader checkout, and prepared all 231 frozen public requests with no gold labels in the inference input. No base weights, GPU allocation or model inference occurred. GPU/public collection and fresh independent sealed evaluation remain pending. See validation.json.
